sections.Profile:
Cue Ball Wizard, released by Gottlieb in October 1992, is a four-player solid-state pool game designed by Jon Norris, a spiritual successor to earlier pool tables like Eight Ball Deluxe with an urban cowboy look. A full-size captive cue ball on the playfield is knocked into two raised targets, which fire a real 8-ball at the targets on an upper level.
